description: Create a playable boss: stats, phases, attacks bound to anim-pack slots, arena, engine snippets. Kit is 0 credits. Reuses a locker enemy when one exists. Pass character_id to bind a Library mesh. Pass generate=true to forge a NEW kind=enemy mesh (10 credits, 2–8 min) — only if the locker is empty. Then gripforge_animate(archetype) + gripforge_hitbox. Name stays text.

generate.description: Forge a new enemy mesh (10 credits)

out_dir.description: Write boss.json + engine snippets (+ GLB if generated) here

prompt.description: e.g. "devil may cry like phantom boss"

role.description: mini | mid | final (inferred from the prompt)

name: gripforge_boss
